blocks.text: `Proposed` records a candidate design choice. `Frozen` binds an executed choice to its recorded protocol and receipts. `Superseded` preserves a consequential replaced decision. `Closed` ends a study without erasing its invalid, null, or negative observations.

| ID | Decision | Current status | Admission rule |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| LH-D01 | Use a genuine cold boundary and compare ordinary versus governed handoff | Frozen | Preserve the same sender state, task, rubric, and worker caps within each pair. |
| LH-D02 | Use version-pinned public LAB Contracts materials as task sources | Frozen | Describe results as Harvey LAB-derived, never as official Harvey leaderboard scores. |
| LH-D03 | Use clean/stress 2×2 cells and three receiver repeats | Frozen | Keep clean quality and controlled trust stress analytically distinct. |
| LH-D04 | Admit only valid paired runs and retain invalid attempts | Frozen | Apply recorded invalidation rules without outcome-dependent exceptions. |
| LH-D05 | Use deterministic checks plus transaction-level policy judging | Frozen | Preserve per-conclusion ledger receipts; no judge recommendation directly grants admission. |
| LH-D06 | Freeze seven complete model panels and exclude terminated Kimi routing | Frozen | Kimi remains route evidence and contributes no zero-effect cell. |
| LH-D07 | Close the current study after 126 valid pairs | Closed | Do not append post-outcome models or scenarios; open a new preregistered study for expansion. |
Each frozen decision must remain linked to the evidence index, immutable result files, source/configuration identity, and retained invalid attempts. A chat transcript alone is not decision evidence.
